name: AI Log Write
description: Every Nemotron inference call triggers a new record in the Airtable AI Log table with module tag, input brief, output text, model ID, and timestamp. This is the audit backbone for the entire orchestrator.

config.description: Receives POST from Cloudflare Worker nemotron-router.js after every inference call
Estimate token count and flag anomalies
config.code: const input = inputData.input_brief || ''; const output = inputData.output_text || ''; const estInputTokens = Math.ceil(input.length / 4); const estOutputTokens = Math.ceil(output.length / 4); const totalTokens = estInputTokens + estOutputTokens; const isFallback = inputData.model !== '@cf/nvidia/nemotron-3-120b-a12b'; output = { est_input_tokens: estInputTokens, est_output_tokens: estOutputTokens, est_total_tokens: totalTokens, is_fallback: isFallback, model_used: inputData.model };
